name: memova
description: Run Memova workflows, manage V2/V3 knowledge roots, and sync opt-in Codex conversation history.

interface.shortDescription: Open Memova setup, tasks, vault diagnosis, and conversation sync.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to Memova through OAuth MCP for knowledge-base and automation workflows. Use @memova to create or diagnose backend-defined Knowledge Base V2/V3 managed roots, review and run automation tasks, and explicitly configure the Codex conversation Collector. Version 1.3.0 adds strict backend-driven V3 setup, scoped conversation pairing, bounded single-task acceptance sync, privacy-safe optional project context, incremental neutral-archive delivery, and thread, device, or all-data deletion.
defaultPrompt: Set up private Codex conversation sync.
